newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buying subdued by U.S. futures.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buying subdued by U.S. futures.

text.p: A strong recovery in New York futures drove buyers away from Europe's raw cotton markets, industry sources reported on Friday.
Interest in Central Asian growths for nearby delivery which have kept the major markets ticking over all week changed down a gear to be fuelled mostly by price testing.
There were few reports of firm contracts and trading on all markets was governed by buyer caution, sources said.
